question: Which house has the most members? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__get_neo4j_schema
mcp__gds-agent__read_neo4j_cypher

parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h, count(DISTINCT p) AS members
WITH collect({name: h.name, members: members}) AS rows, max(members) AS maxMembers
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row, maxMembers
WHERE row.members = maxMembers
RETURN row.name AS house
ORDER BY house

tools.name: mcp__gds-agent__read_neo4j_cypher

parameters.query:
MATCH (h:House)
WITH h, COUNT { (h)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(:Person) } AS members
ORDER BY members DESC
WITH collect({name: h.name, members: members}) AS ranked
WITH ranked, ranked[0].members AS maxMembers
UNWIND ranked AS row
WITH row, maxMembers
WHERE row.members = maxMembers
RETURN row.name AS house
ORDER BY house

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:King)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h, count(DISTINCT k) AS kings
WITH collect({house: h.name, kings: kings}) AS rows, max(kings) AS maxKings

parameters.cypher_query:
MATCH (k1:King), (k2:King)
WHERE elementId(k1) < elementId(k2)
OPTIONAL MATCH (k1)-[:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]->(b1:Battle)
WITH k1, k2, collect(DISTINCT b1) AS s1
OPTIONAL MATCH (k2)-[:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]->(b2:Battle)
WITH k1, k2, s1, collect(DISTINCT b2) AS s2
WITH k1, k2,
     [b IN s1 WHERE b IN s2] AS shared,
     s1 + [b IN s2 WHERE NOT b IN s1] AS unionSet
WHERE size(shared) > 0
WITH k1, k2, toFloat(size(shared)) / size(unionSet) AS similarity
RETURN gds.graph.project(
  $graph_name,
  k1,
  k2,
  {
    sourceNodeLabels: labels(k1),
    targetNodeLabels: labels(k2),
    relationshipType: 'SIMILAR',
    relationshipProperties: {similarity: similarity}
  },
  {undirectedRelationshipTypes: ['SIMILAR']}
)

parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h, collect(DISTINCT p) AS people
WITH collect({house: h.name, members: size(people)}) AS rows
WITH rows, reduce(mx = 0, row IN rows | CASE WHEN row.members > mx THEN row.members ELSE mx END) AS maxMembers
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row, maxMembers WHERE row.members = maxMembers
